result:
I've changed sign-up to follow ADR 0003, which outranks the product notes. `tsc --noEmit` is clean, but I didn't run the test suite or try any of the reported cases by hand.

**Reports 1 and 5 (names)**
- Sign-up now uses the name's slug only if it is valid and not reserved. Otherwise the workspace slug is `workspace`, with a numeric suffix if that is taken. This covers "Admin", "Billing", "J" and names with no Latin letters.
- The workspace name is `<name>'s workspace`. The name is shortened so the whole thing fits the 64-character limit and still ends in `'s workspace`.

**Report 2 (email case)**
- The user lookup and the user insert both trim and lowercase the address in `user-repository.ts`. This covers sign-up, sign-in and password reset.

**Report 3 (throttling)**
- Sign-up now spends one token from a new `auth:register` bucket before anything is written.
- Sign-in, password-reset confirmation and sign-up now throw `RateLimitedError`. `toAppError` maps it to `rate_limited`, so people see a wait message instead of "Something went wrong".
- Sign-in used to be charged twice per attempt, once in the action and once in the service. I removed the charge in `actions/auth/login.ts` and kept the one in the service.

**Report 4 (existing address)**
- Signing up with an existing address now throws `AccountExistsError`, which maps to `conflict`. Nothing is created.

The first workspace already started on the Free plan with an active subscription, so I left that alone.
